story.title: From Masterbatch Manufacturing to Sustainable Plastic Solutions
paragraphs: Founded in 2008, Xuanpin has been dedicated to masterbatch manufacturing for nearly two decades. From the beginning, we focused on providing reliable filler masterbatch solutions for plastic manufacturers, building our expertise through continuous innovation, quality improvement, and close cooperation with customers.

Over the years, the global plastics industry has been undergoing significant changes. With increasing demand for sustainable materials and the growing transition toward environmentally responsible plastics, Xuanpin has expanded its capabilities beyond traditional masterbatch solutions into biodegradable and functional materials.

Today, our product portfolio covers biodegradable masterbatch solutions, including PBAT/PLA A/B masterbatch systems, as well as mineral filled and functional masterbatch solutions such as calcium carbonate, barium sulfate, talc, desiccant, PPA, and other performance additives.

Supported by multiple manufacturing facilities, a professional marketing center, and an annual production capacity exceeding 100,000 tons, we provide stable supply, customized formulations, and technical support to plastic manufacturers worldwide.
Our mission is not only to manufacture masterbatch, but also to help customers achieve better performance, cost efficiency, and more sustainable plastic solutions for the future.
